content: I was shocked and saddened to learn that Om Malik died. I always enjoyed his writing and his photography. I didn’t know him personally, but by all accounts, he was a really good human. Knowing that he had such a long battle with heart disease really reframes some of his writing, especially what is now his final blog post. I hope and trust that his family and/or friends will keep his online presence alive. The world is a better place with his words and photos available for others to enjoy. Farewell, Om. You will be missed by many.
